title: Large Language Model Hacking: Quantifying the Hidden Risks of Using LLMs for Text Annotation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical reliability and reproducibility of LLM-based text annotation, specifically exploring how configuration choices affect scientific conclusions. Although it utilizes datasets covering ethical and social topics such as hate speech and misinformation, these are used as vehicles to measure statistical significance discrepancies (Type I, II, S, and M errors) rather than as a primary evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
